sourceFile: 62. BRS-161016 Check new magnetic machine (QM data)_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the comparison and uses invalid statistics/evidence for an old-vs-new magnetic machine gauss check.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not old vs new magnetic machine.
Baseline/test conditions omit machine and voltage details.
Date groups and repeated old/new comparisons are not preserved.
Statistics appear corrupted by summary rows or wrong columns.
Evidence cites only spec row, not condition headers or result rows.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to equipment: old magnetic machine vs new magnetic machine.
Use old machine 906V as baseline and new machine 2153V/2212V as changed conditions.
Preserve date groups 2024-09-19 and 2024-09-20 as subgroup context.
Rebuild outcome metrics from rows 6-9 and sample rows without mixing summary labels as measurements.
Cite rows 3-9 at minimum, plus sample rows used for any computed stats.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citation is insufficient; condition headers, dates, specs, and statistics need row citations.
